Use the command-line updater when new tournaments are added:

```sh
Rscript scripts/update_ddc_tournament_data.R
```

The scraper functions live in `scripts/ddc_scraper.R`; this notebook is now for inspection and one-off runs.

```{r setup}
source("scripts/update_ddc_tournament_data.R")
```

Scrape a known range and save the full tournament data:

```{r scrape-range, eval=FALSE}
existing_data <- read_existing_data("data/output/ddc_full_tournament_data_auto.csv")
latest_tournament_id <- if (is.null(existing_data)) {
  0L
} else {
  max(existing_data$TournamentID, na.rm = TRUE)
}
event_ids <- seq(latest_tournament_id + 1L, latest_tournament_id + 50L)

new_tournaments <- scrape_ddc_events(event_ids, delay_seconds = 2)
new_tournaments <- normalize_tournament_data(new_tournaments)

combined <- dedupe_tournament_rows(
  dplyr::bind_rows(existing_data, new_tournaments)
)
write_tournament_csv(
  combined,
  "data/output/ddc_full_tournament_data_auto.csv"
)
write_tournament_csv(
  make_team_data(combined),
  "data/output/ddc_team_data.csv"
)

head(combined)
```

For routine updates, prefer the script because it automatically starts after the highest existing `TournamentID`, appends newly found rows, removes duplicate tournament/team rows, and updates the team-only CSV.
